MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Reproduction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Ecology and Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
